sanctuary.title: THE SANCTUARY
sanctuary.quote: "Here, nothing is evaluated. Something is simply left."

essence.title: The essence
essence.description1: Transcendence is not a game. It is an experimental digital space where players explore the cosmos—a vast network of creative artifacts created by a collective.
essence.description2:
It is a place for expression without evaluation. For exploration without competition. For creation without judgment.

This is where your imagination takes form.

die.title: The Die
die.description:
At the heart of Transcendence lies the Die—a 3D digital object that represents possibility, chance, and creative potential.

The Die evolves as you interact with it. Each artistic contribution adds new dimensions to its existence. Each exploration leaves a trace. Each creation shapes its evolution.
die.philosophy: Every choice adds a dimension. Every creation resonates.

dormant.title: Dormant — observation
dormant.description:
In its dormant state, the Die awaits. You observe. You explore. You understand the cosmos without leaving your mark.

This is pure observation. The foundation of all creation.

active.title: Active — exploration
active.description:
The Active state is where exploration becomes intentional. You navigate through the stars, discovering artworks created by others.

You unlock the Die's potential through participation. Each discovery is a key. Each exploration is a journey.

creative.title: Creative — co-creation
creative.description:
In Creative mode, you become a co-creator. You paint, you imagine, you shape the Die's future.

Your artwork becomes part of the cosmos. Your creation influences others. Together, we build something transcendent.

stars.title: The stars
stars.description1: The cosmos is made of stars—each one a unique artwork. Each star has its own history, its own resonance.
stars.description2: Stars can be explored, discovered, and collected. They form constellations. They create meaning through connection.
stars.description3: You are both a star and a explorer. Your creations shine. Your journey illuminates the path for others.

blockchain.title: Blockchain — durable memory
blockchain.description: Every artwork you create is recorded on the blockchain—ensuring permanent memory and true ownership.
blockchain.philosophy:
Your creations are yours. Immutable. Permanent. Beyond any central authority.

Transcendence leverages blockchain to guarantee the permanence of collective creation.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.description: By accessing and using Transcendence, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement.

nature.title: 2. Nature of the service
nature.description: Transcendence is an experimental digital space for creative exploration and expression. The service is provided as-is without warranties.

creation.title: 3. User responsibilities
creation.description: Users agree not to create, upload, or share content that is illegal, harmful, hateful, or violates others' rights.

blockchain.title: 4. Blockchain persistence
blockchain.description: All artworks are permanently stored on the blockchain. This ensures your creations cannot be censored or removed.

irreversibility.title: 5. Irreversibility
irreversibility.description: Blockchain transactions are permanent and irreversible. Users must understand the implications before creating.

account.title: 6. Account responsibility
account.description: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You are liable for all activities under your account.

behavior.title: 7. User conduct
behavior.description: Users must behave respectfully. Harassment, abuse, or violations of others' rights may result in account suspension.

dataCollected.title: 1. Data collected
dataCollected.description: We collect minimal data: username, email, and artwork metadata necessary for the service to function.

dataUse.title: 2. Data use
dataUse.description: Your data is used only to provide the service, improve functionality, and maintain security.

ai.title: 3. AI processing
ai.description: Some features use AI to enhance your experience. AI processes your inputs but does not store them for training purposes.

security.title: 4. Security
security.description: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no system is completely secure.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description1: Transcendence uses cookies to enhance user experience and maintain session information.
cookies.description2: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.description: All content created on Transcendence is owned by the creator. By uploading content, you grant Transcendence a license to display and preserve your work.

contact.description: For questions or concerns, please contact us at
